chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about a free man who marries a slave girl of a group of people, are the children slaves or free? He said: If one of the two parents is free, then the children are free.
A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, similar to it.
ai.seo_question: What is the status of children when one parent is free and the other is a slave?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'freeing by one parent' (Umm al-Walad), where the child of a free man and a slave woman is born free, reflecting the Shia juristic consensus on lineage and emancipation. It highlights the social and legal elevation of the offspring, ensuring they are not bound by the mother's servitude, a key concept in Islamic family law.
